name: metrics-cagr-multiyear
description: Two winning trades on fixed 1000 invested, spaced EXACTLY 730.5 days (two 365.25-day years) apart. Pins the CAGR annualization exponent: with a 2-year span the exponent is 1/2, so cagr (0.10) MUST differ from pnlTotalPercent (21%). The metrics-mixed-trades fixture cannot guard this — its 365.25-day span makes the exponent exactly 1, where annualized CAGR and total return coincide, so a bug that returned total return instead of CAGR would pass there. (1210/1000)^(1/2) - 1 = 0.10. Sharpe/Sortino are intentionally not asserted here: with two same-sign returns Sortino's downside set is empty (degenerate); this fixture is CAGR-focused.
